svg.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Capability tier map
svg.desc: The 43 capabilities by function and by the lowest tier that should adopt them: Essential, Standard or Advanced. A red dot marks capabilities that carry the NIS2 legal floor; for an entity in NIS2 scope they are never above tier. DE-2 and PR-8 also have a basic form in Essential.
svg.text: the defensible minimum and the NIS2 floor
Carries the NIS2 legal floor: never above tier for an entity in scope
